models: M0: occupancy psi and constant detection p (2 parameters)
M1: occupancy psi, site-specific latent p_i ~ Beta(alpha,beta), with independent daily Bernoulli conditional on p_i (3 parameters)
likelihood: for positive history psi*B(k+alpha,n-k+beta)/B(alpha,beta); for all-zero history (1-psi)+psi*B(alpha,n+beta)/B(alpha,beta); exact binary sequence likelihood without combinatorial term
optimization: scipy L-BFGS-B multistart on logit psi and log alpha,log beta, bounds, convergence and finite checks
outputs: beta mean detection and site-level detection SD
caveats: Latent site heterogeneity is statistical, not measured ecological mechanism
Beta mixing also induces positive within-site temporal dependence; no independent proof of source
No daily effort or actual calendar dates, closure unverified
No A/B/M causal inference or EOG geometry
